verdict.rationale: The 01 executes code, manages files and controls software on the user's computer, so a sandboxed test environment is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence describes a sandbox, an isolated environment, a dry-run mode, or any separation from production data. Editable server profiles are a configuration feature, not isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
